note.question: How should contract be designed for a national brand manufacturer under store brand private information?
note.overview: This paper studies an optimal contract design problem for a national brand (NB) manufacturer, which sells her product via a retailer. The retailer may introduce his store brand (SB) with private cost information. The manufacturer estimates that the retailer’s SB cost may be high or low with certain probabilities and offers a menu of two-part tariff contracts to screen the retailer’s cost information.
